cohort: The study collected breast milk samples, maternal feces, and infant meconium from mothers and their infants.
finding: The 2bRAD-M method demonstrated high accuracy and robustness in profiling species-level microbial composition compared to whole metagenomics sequencing and effectively identified associations between clinical variables or lactation stages and maternal-infant microbiota variations.
cross-section timing: Samples were collected from infant meconium and at different lactation stages of breast milk.
